ideas.children_he: הֲכָנַת הַקּוֹרְבָּנוֹת וַהַמַּצּוֹת — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Preparing a bull, two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread for consecrating the priests. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: רַחֲצָה וְהַלְבָּשֶׁת אַהֲרֹן וּבִנָיוּ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Aaron and his sons are washed, dressed in sacred garments, and prepared for priestly service. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: קָרְבָּן הַחַטָּאת שֶׁל הֵפֵר — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Aaron and his sons lay hands on the bull; its blood is placed on the altar and the remainder is burned outside the camp. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: הַקְּרָבַת הָאַיִל הָרִאשׁוֹן — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The first ram is offered as a burnt offering and completely burned on the altar. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: קִידּוּשׁ הַכּוֹהֲנִים בַּדָּם הָאַיִל — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The second ram is offered, and its blood and anointing oil consecrate the priests and their garments. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: תְּנוּפַת אֵיל הַמִּילּוּאִים וְהַלֶּחֶם — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Parts of the ram and unleavened breads are placed in the priests’ hands, waved before God, and burned on the altar. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: מַתָּנוֹת הַכְּהוּנָּה לְדוֹרוֹת — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The waved breast is given to Moses, while the breast and thigh become perpetual priestly portions from Israel. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: הֶמְשֵׁךְ הַכְּהוּנָּה בְּבִגְדֵי הַקּוֹדֶשׁ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Aaron’s sacred garments pass to his sons, and each succeeding priest wears them for seven days of service. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: אֲכִילַת אֵיל הַמִּילּוּאִים וּשְׂרֵיפַת הַנּוֹתָר — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The ordination ram is cooked in a holy place. Aaron and his sons eat its meat and the bread at the Tent of Meeting, while leftovers are burned and outsiders may not eat. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: שֶׁבְּעַת יְמֵי קִידּוּשׁ הַכּוֹהֲנִים וְהַמִּזְבֵּחַ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: For seven days Aaron and his sons are ordained. A sin offering is made each day, and the altar is atoned for and consecrated as most holy. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: קָרְבָּן הִתָמִיד בַּבּוֹקֶר וּבֵין הָעַרְבַיִים — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Two year-old lambs are offered every day, one in the morning and one at twilight, together with a flour offering, oil, and wine libation as a pleasing offering to God. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: אוֹהֶל מוֹעֵד כִּמְקוֹם הִתְוַועֲדוּת — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The continual offering is kept for all generations at the Tent of Meeting, where God meets Israel, speaks with Moses, and sanctifies the place with His glory. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: שְׁכִינַת ה׳ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: God sanctifies the Tent of Meeting, the altar, Aaron, and his sons for priestly service. He dwells among Israel as their God who brought them out of Egypt. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.
